name: Panty
summary: Braga is one of the oldest cities in Portugal (of Roman origin, the ancient Bracara Augusta) and today combines a monumental historical center - with the sanctuary of Bom Jesus do Monte as a great icon - with a cost of living clearly lower than Lisbon and Porto. It is home to the University of Minho, which gives it a young population and a very active cultural life, and in recent years it has developed a growing technological ecosystem that coexists with its traditional character. It is less than an hour by train from Porto, making it easy to access an international airport without living in a big city.
